name: Furie™ AI Chat / Live Handoff, Auto Engagement, and Lead Generation
author: furieai

sections.description:
Furie™ is an AI-powered chat widget built to increase conversions, capture leads, and assist customers with real-time intelligence.
Just install the plugin, choose your Property ID, and Furie™ appears instantly on your site — no coding required.

🌟 Features

  • Real-time visitor tracking (“Live Browsing”).
  • Lead scoring and prospect analysis.
  • AI Chatbot powered by your brand, training data, redirects, and intelligent behavior.
  • Live agent takeover & routing queues.
  • Promo Pops™ for boosted engagement and sales (upselling based on current item in cart, etc.).
  • Full chat widget customization (colors, avatars, position, branding).
  • Multi-business-unit support (FREE).
  • Advanced reporting for agents & performance.
  • FREE FOREVER — no trial limits or credit card numbers.

🔧 How it Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Sign up at Furie.ai to get your Property ID from the Admin → Properties tab.
  3. Go to Settings → Furie AI Chat Widget.Enter your Property ID (default is 29).
  4. Furie™ instantly loads on your website using this embed:

You can update the Property ID anytime.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from WordPress or upload the ZIP.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Furie AI Chat Widget.
  4. Enter your Property ID. (Set up your account at https://furie.ai/livechat/subscribe.php and the Property ID will be under Admin>Properties.)
  5. Save changes — the widget will now appear on your site.
sections.faq:
Is Furie™ really FREE FOREVER?

Yes. All core features — AI chat, live agent handoff, branding, routing, script integration — are completely free.

Can I install this plugin on multiple sites?

Yes, each site can use a different Property ID.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Furie™ automatically loads once the Property ID is saved.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The script is lightweight and loads asynchronously.
